json_ld.description:
The Swamp Cooler™ Harness is a trail-ready, all-in-one cooling solution for dogs exploring in hot conditions, now with a third leash attachment point on the chest. Integrated directly into our three-strap harness platform, it leverages our Swamp Cooler™ technology to pull body surface heat away through evaporative cooling. Dial in a secure and comfortable fit with six adjustment points, lift and assist with the quick-grab handle, and stay connected with three leash connection points as you head out together on your next summer endeavor.  
How does Swamp Cooler™ Tech work? Learn more here about how that refreshing, just-stepped-out-of-a-lake feeling known as evaporative cooling helps keep your dog cool. Check out the Swamp Cooler™ Collection.
